abstract: Choriocarcinoma of the uterus developed in an Rh0(D)-negative woman six weeks after delivery of a normal Rh0(D)-positive child. Although the patient's medical history did not show any previous sensitization, a strong anti-Rh0(D) antibody was detected during evaluation preceding surgical removal of the tumor. The tumor was considered the most probable cause of the Rh0(D) sensitization, since large Rh0(D)-positive areas of tumor were demonstrated by the immunoperoxidase method. This finding indicates that the Rh0(D) antigen is not restricted to erythrocytes, as commonly assumed, but can also be expressed on other tissue, such as tumor tissue.
abstract_ja: 正常なRh0(D)陽性児の出産の6週間後にRh0(D)陰性の女性に子宮絨毛癌が発生した。既往歴には感作の記録がなかったが、腫瘍摘出術前の評価で強い抗Rh0(D)抗体が検出された。免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法により腫瘍の広範なRh0(D)陽性領域が示されたことから、腫瘍がRh0(D)感作の原因であると考えられた。この所見は、Rh0(D)抗原が通常想定されているように赤血球に限局されるものではなく、腫瘍組織などの他の組織にも発現しうることを示している。
